intro.text: John McGregor spent more than 30 years in the credit union and financial industry, leading retail banking and lending teams. He started JM Management Solutions so small and mid-sized Long Island businesses get the same financial discipline big companies have: books in order, clear numbers and plain-English advice. You work directly with John, not a call center.
intro.quote: Know your numbers. Run your business better.

items.d: Day-to-day bookkeeping, transaction organization and account reconciliation.
Cash flow analysis, expense tracking and monthly reporting.
Tailored strategy and process improvement built around how your industry actually works.
Credit profile guidance and loan-readiness planning from someone who led bank lending teams for decades.

items.h: Supplemental coverage for owners and teams.
items.d: Accident, critical illness, cancer, disability, life and hospital policies that pay cash benefits.

reviews.text: Your review helps the next Long Island business owner find a partner they can trust.

faq: Yes. Tell John about your business and he follows up personally, usually within one business day.

No. Pick where you need help, or John can build a plan that covers it all.
